Because the copper burn is recorded at the anchor settlement, the orchard audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 51% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. A 293 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
